Definition: to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy a debt
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be pleased with, be favourable to, accept favourably; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be pleased with, be favourable to; 1a2) to accept; 1a3) to be pleased, be determined; 1a4) to make acceptable, satisfy; 1a5) to please; 1b) (Niphal) to be accepted, be pleased with; 1c) (Piel) to seek favour of; 1d) (Hiphil) to please, pay off; 1e) (Hithpael) to make oneself acceptable or pleasing
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
